top: He scratched a $100,000 lottery win. The lottery told him it was a $20 misprint.
comment: According to his post, they pulled the whole game a few hours later. Would you take the $20 or fight it?
topic_it: Utente Reddit: gratta e vinci da 100.000 dollari, la lotteria dice che è un errore di stampa e paga 20 dollari; il gioco ritirato ore dopo

title: Winning $100,000 only to be told it's a mistake #lottery #shocking #fail
description:
His scratch ticket showed a $100,000 win, but the lottery said it was a $20 misprint and pulled the game hours later, according to his post. Photo via r/mildlyinfuriating.
